bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cd /home/admin1/server-core
before=fda997ca2e008cea74ffed11955c3af9e2158462
target=9e654a5c84b1750540296adcf26a32920465c2ea
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$before"
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- scripts/servercore_result_sink.py tests/servercore_result_return_test.py docs/GITHUB_PROJECT_CHAT_HOST_ROUTE.md)"
git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null fetch --no-write-fetch-head origin "$target"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$before" "$target"
test "$(git rev-parse "$target:scripts/servercore_result_sink.py")" = 2617bc59f037facfaaf6783e28c3d5ba0af3bcca
git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null merge --ff-only "$target"
if ! systemctl --user restart gace-servercore-result-sink.service || ! systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-servercore-result-sink.service; then
  git show "$before:scripts/servercore_result_sink.py" > scripts/servercore_result_sink.py
  systemctl --user restart gace-servercore-result-sink.service || true
  printf 'SINK_ROLLBACK_ATTEMPTED\n'
  exit 80
fi
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$target"
printf 'SINK_ROLLOUT_PASS\n'
